verdict.rationale: Gmail documents its own RESTful API for programmatic, UI-free mailbox access and sending, including automated message sending. It also supports server push notifications to backend applications and IMAP/SMTP with OAuth 2.0, so headless automation from server or CI-style code is possible. However, nothing documents a CLI, CI-specific usage, or non-interactive credentials, and community reports describe OAuth restrictions on third-party apps that complicate unattended setups. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented non-interactive or service-account auth for CI pipelines, and hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
